changes.old: Initial state: caster A has no Veil when A commits an eligible rank-3 damaging spell against protected B; B has Spell Shield and a Reaction. The source spell does not create its damage root until its ordinary damage-resolution checkpoint. B reflects before that checkpoint. Spell Shield creates no replacement root and does not move the checkpoint. A remains caster/dealer. A's Veil state is unchanged (none) through the real root checkpoint, so the root is ordinary lethal-capable damage; B's Veil state is irrelevant. If the source spell had created its root before reflection, its existing flag would simply be preserved.
changes.replacement: Exact comparison: Wizard A (class7, PB3, INT+4, spell attack+7, current RP20, current HP8/max30, AC12, no tempHP or acid defense) has ordinary Acid Arrow legally prepared and remains under unsuppressed Null Veil throughout this fixture. B, 20ft away with line of effect, has one active Spell Shield and a Reaction; return range30ft and targeting are legal. A commits rank2 Acid Arrow, pays its base3RP (RP20 to17; no extra price modifiers), and applies its actual casting hooks. After the legal interruption window B spends its Reaction and the shield to redirect the same pending spell. Spell Shield creates no replacement damage root and does not advance the original spell's real root checkpoint. A remains caster/dealer. The returned ranged attack rolls12+7=19 against A's AC12 and hits; initial4d4=10 acid. At the original damage-root creation checkpoint A is Veiled, so that actual root is nullNonlethal. With no defenses/tempHP, A reaches Stable0 rather than damage-caused death/Wounds; establish the ordinary one Stable recovery deadline. The same continuing A identity receives Acid Arrow's finite2d4 delayed rider, due at A's first future regular END excluding the current turn. When that rider deals5 acid at its proper marker, it inherits the original root flag and leaves already-Stable0 A with the same recovery deadline, even if Veil has ended after root creation. No second cast, payment, reflection, target or root is created by Shield. Boundary comparison at the existing root checkpoint: with an un-Veiled original dealer at creation, that root is ordinary; later Veil gain cannot rewrite it. If an independently completed lawful event changes Veil before actual root creation, use the then-current dealer state. This comparison grants no new event window and does not equate cast commitment with root creation.
